summary: LGY Accountants (lgy.com.au, ABN registered 2008) is a small Melbourne accounting firm offering tax, bookkeeping and training, with Xero and QuickBooks support named on its site. The identity of the contact could not be locked: the same Harry Liu bio and the same colleagues (Xi, Sherry) also appear on the team page of Beyond Accountancy at 883 Toorak Road, Camberwell, and LGY's own site now lists a Camberwell address rather than the Queen St CBD address on record. It is unclear whether Harry still works at LGY, so no follow-up is drafted.
